meta.title: Foundation Documents - Open Healthcare Network Foundation
meta.description: Legal registration, compliance, and certification documents for Open Healthcare Network Foundation, including COI, MOA, AOA, PAN, GST, 80G, 12A, and ISO certificates.

hero.title: Foundation documents.
hero.body: Legal, compliance, and certification documents for Open Healthcare Network Foundation — available for funders, partners, and implementation organisations.

tax.title: Tax registration and statutory compliance.
tax.body: Donations to OHC Foundation are eligible for 80G tax deduction. For donation receipts, contact <link>{email}</link>.

incorporationCertificate.title: Certificate of Incorporation
incorporationCertificate.description: Official certificate issued by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs confirming registration as a Section 8 company.

moa.title: Memorandum of Association (MOA)
moa.description: Defines the foundation's objects, scope, purpose, and the limits within which it may operate.

aoa.title: Articles of Association (AOA)
aoa.description: Governs the foundation's internal management, meeting rules, officer roles, and operational procedures.

section8License.title: Section 8 License
section8License.description: License granted under Section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013, confirming non-profit status and purpose.

pan.title: PAN Card
pan.description: Permanent Account Number issued by the Income Tax Department of India.

tan.title: TAN Certificate
tan.description: Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number for compliance with TDS obligations.

gst.title: GST Certificate
gst.description: Goods and Services Tax registration certificate issued by the GST Council.

lut.title: LUT (GST) 2026–27
lut.description: Letter of Undertaking filed under GST for zero-rated supply of services without payment of integrated tax.

registration12a.title: 12A Provisional Registration (Form 10AC)
registration12a.description: Income tax exemption registration for non-profit organisations under Section 12A of the Income Tax Act, 1961.

registration80g.title: 80G Provisional Registration (Form 10AC)
registration80g.description: Certificate enabling donors to claim tax deductions on contributions to the foundation under Section 80G.

msme.title: MSME Certificate
msme.description: Udyam registration under the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act.

darpan.title: NGO Darpan Registration
darpan.description: Registration with the NGO Darpan portal, a NITI Aayog initiative for transparency in non-profit organisations.

iso.title: Certified for security and health software safety.
iso.body: OHC Foundation holds ISO 27001:2022, ISO 82304-1:2016, and ISO 82304-2:2021 certifications covering information security management and health software safety requirements.
